name: datacircle
description: Datacircle is a data co-op. Query your favorite B2B data APIs through us. Same request, same price, no markup. Right now we have 2 live LinkedIn profile APIs that we trust: Up2Data and HarvestAPI. Hosted remote server: sign in through your MCP client (OAuth, your work email and a code on datacircle.dev), or send your Datacircle API key as an Authorization Bearer header.

http.description: Hosted streamable-HTTP MCP server. Your MCP client opens datacircle.dev for a one-time sign-in with your work email; a new account starts with a $5 credit.

tools.name: get_linkedin_profile
tools.description: Fetch one person's LinkedIn profile by its URL (name, headline, location, current company and title, positions, education, skills) through Up2Data or HarvestAPI, at the provider's own price from the Datacircle balance, with no markup.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Read the Datacircle balance in USD and what it is made of. Free.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List the data files this account can download, such as the free 10M+ US B2B leads dataset, each with whether it is unlocked. Free.

tools.name: get_download_link
tools.description: Get a signed download link, valid one hour, for one file from list_files. Free.

tools.name: add_funds
tools.description: Start a Stripe Checkout that adds funds to the Datacircle balance; nothing is charged until the user pays it.

tools.name: get_invite_link
tools.description: Get this account's invite link and how many people signed up with it. Free.

examples.title: LinkedIn profile
examples.description: Look up one person's profile from its URL
examples.prompt: Look up https://www.linkedin.com/in/williamhgates with Datacircle and summarise his career.

examples.title: Balance
examples.description: Check what the lookups can spend
